{#- preset — one configuration card: what you set on top, a picture of what it produces underneath. Written for the statusline presets, but nothing in it is statusline-specific: any setting whose result is visible in a capture fits. Block form. Arguments are title, src, alt and note; the BODY is the setting itself, normally a fenced code block, and is rendered as Markdown — so it picks up highlighting and the copy button like any other block on the page. (No usage sample here: a literal tag inside a comment is still parsed, and a shortcode template that shows its own call refuses to render. See docs/content/guide/statusline.md for real calls.) An `src` under /images/tui/ gets the light/dark swap the other captures get (footer.html), so a strip only needs a twin under images/tui/light/. -#}
